description: Work out the hourly or day rate a freelancer or consultant needs to charge, once unbillable time is accounted for. Answers "what should I charge per hour?" from target annual income, business costs, working weeks and realistic billable hours.

annualBusinessCosts.description: Annual business costs: software, insurance, accountant, equipment.

billableHoursPerWeek.description: Hours a week genuinely billed, not hours worked.

targetAnnualIncome.description: What you want to earn in a year, before tax.

workingWeeksPerYear.description: Weeks worked a year, after holiday and illness.

name: forge_freelance_rate
